notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
description:
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing the creature that has Screams from Within attached.
When the creature dies, Screams from Within triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
Sela triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Reaper of Flight Moonsilver ability.
Repeat.

uses.name: Screams from Within
